note: Frozen tools. The buyer talks to their AI. The AI calls these tools. No paste UI required.

tools.name: list_panels
tools.description: List Artiphact e-ink panels plugged in over USB.

tools.name: push_artifact
tools.description: Push a finished 800x480 black/white HTML or SVG page to the Artiphact panel now. Use this after you build charts/dashboards from the user's data (including SQL results they pasted). Self-contained HTML only — no external URLs inside the page. You may look up live data first, then bake the numbers into the HTML.

tools.name: start_live_update
tools.description: Start a recurring live feed on the Artiphact panel so it stays up to date without the user pasting anything. Use when the user asks to keep scores or similar data current. kind=nfl_scores refreshes NFL scoreboard HTML on an interval.

tools.name: stop_live_update
tools.description: Stop a live feed previously started with start_live_update. Omit kind to stop all live feeds.

tools.name: set_wifi
tools.description: Send home Wi-Fi name and password to the panel over USB.
